podcast.body: This album is noted for being full of cover songs and contained Olivia Newton-John's first hit single, "If Not For You," a cover of Bob Dylan's song. Other covers included "Me and Bobby McGee," "If You Could Read My Mind," "If," and "Help Me Make It Through the Night." "If not for you, the album is full of cover songs."
